cues.text: You're lifting every day, but still look
skinny in clothes?
Let me fix [music] that. Here are three
mistakes keeping you small, even with
all that effort. First, you only train
mirror muscles: chest, [music]
biceps, abs. Sure, they look good, but
what makes you look big is your frame:
shoulders, traps, and neck. Neglect
[music] them, and your body always looks
narrow, no matter how much you lift.
Second, you're not eating enough. You
can't grow if you're always cutting.
Stop fearing carbs. Your muscles need
fuel, not just protein shakes and hopes.
Third, bad posture. Rounded shoulders
make your frame collapse. Fix your
posture, and you'll look five times
stronger instantly, even without gaining
a gram of muscle. That's it. Three fixes
that change how your body looks before
it even changes in size.
